verdict.rationale_short: Today is the final day of Q2 2026 — window dressing provides near-term support as portfolio managers lock in a historic quarter (SPX +14%, Nasdaq +19.6%). But the two regime gates remain uncleared after June 29's best Nasdaq session in three weeks: SPX closed at 7,440 (still 20 pts below the 7,460 floor) and VIX never broke below 17 on a CLOSE basis. NVDA's Stop Day 2 mandatory exit is in progress at the open ($193.85), creating forced institutional selling in the AI bellwether. BTC fell to $59,399 overnight (Day 9 exit gate), confirming that even yesterday's Dow record + SCOTUS + Iran stand-down cocktail couldn't sustain crypto risk appetite. NFP July 2 (consensus 170K) with an unhedgeable July 4 gap is the week's decisive binary. HOLD at medium conviction; BUY upgrade conditional on SPX closing above 7,460 AND VIX closing below 17 simultaneously today.

bear_case: The regime gate failure is the bear case's core data point. June 29 delivered four simultaneous tailwinds — Dow record (52,182), SCOTUS Fed independence ruling, Iran stand-down confirmation, and a Nasdaq surge of +2.07% — conditions that, historically, accompany regime-clearing sessions. SPX closed at 7,440: 20 points short of the 7,460 floor. VIX closed at approximately 17.65: 0.65 points above the 17 gate. Eight consecutive sessions have rejected both gates simultaneously. Today's Q2 window dressing is the last mechanical tailwind of the quarter — tomorrow, July 1, this support disappears. If SPX cannot close above 7,460 on a Dow record + SCOTUS day, it likely cannot close above 7,460 on an ordinary Tuesday post-quarter-end. BTC at $59,399 is the confirming read-through: risk appetite in the most speculative segment of the market deteriorated overnight on the best macro day of the quarter. Forced NVDA exit selling adds institutional supply to the AI bellwether at the open — the #1 Nasdaq growth weight entering forced distribution on the same session that window dressing is supposed to lift index prices. If both of these competing flows (window dressing in vs. NVDA forced exit out) produce a flat or negative close, the next decision point is the 7,300 BEARISH escalation level before NFP July 2. Invalidation: SPX closes above 7,460 AND VIX closes below 17 simultaneously today — the first formal regime gate clearance in eight sessions, and the first BUY upgrade candidate since early June.
